title: Sources of Information
notes: The guide gives this dataset the Terminals Information endpoint (#26). Confirm the correct endpoint with CBK.

fields.name: CREDIT REFERENCE BUREAU CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ = 060002)

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: SOURCE REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The date when the report was last submitted by the source to the Credit Reference Bureau

fields.name: CBK APPROVAL DATE
fields.description: The date when the data source was approved by CBK in the format {DD/MM/YYYY}

fields.name: SOURCE OF INFORMATION TYPE
fields.description: The type of institution providing information to the Credit Reference Bureau. E.g. {Institutions Licensed Under Banking Act, Microfinance Act, Higher Education Loans Board, Public Domain, Individual SACCOs, etc}

fields.name: COUNTY CODE
fields.description: The county code of the where the source of information is located

fields.name: TOWN
fields.description: The name of the town where the source of information is located

fields.name: NATURE OF INFORMATION
fields.description: The nature of information submitted. E.g. {Prescribed customer information, Loan applicant's identification details, Company/Business Registration, Personal Identification Numbers, Winding up, Debt repayment information, etc}
